group: (F53^2 x C17) semidirect H48, H48=<beta,alpha|beta^3=alpha^16=1, alpha beta alpha^-1=beta^-1>
H_normal_form: beta^u alpha^v; u mod3, v mod16
multiplication: (X,c,u,v)*(Y,d,U,V)=(X+rho(u,v)Y, c+5^v*d mod17, u+(-1)^v*U mod3, v+V mod16)
inverse_formula: u_inv=-(-1)^v*u mod3; v_inv=-v mod16; X_inv=-rho(u_inv,v_inv)X; c_inv=-5^(v_inv)*c mod17
adjacency: For each positive generator and its true inverse, add the right-product edge g--g*s.
global_diameter_proof: Left multiplication preserves every right-step Cayley edge. Complete identity BFS reaches all vertices in each case, so its eccentricity equals exact global diameter.
simple_6regular_proof: All six generator IDs are distinct and nonidentity; verified inverse pairs multiply to identity in the new group model. Right multiplication is a bijection.
